controlDescriptions.patternDensity: Sets the scale and spacing of region motifs.
controlDescriptions.patternGrowth: Reveals and releases marks through staggered local phrases, with longitudinal growth along ribbons.
controlDescriptions.patternMotion: Adds slow movement within attached patterns.
controlDescriptions.patternRest: Keeps selected regions quiet between dense patterns.
controlDescriptions.patternStrength: Blends motif ink into the watercolor.
controlDescriptions.patternTravel: Zero keeps motifs attached; higher values add deliberate slow flow inside their region.
controlDescriptions.patternVariation: Varies motif size and curvature within each family.
controlDescriptions.structuralActivity: Zero preserves the previous scene. Higher values grow curved splits, close narrow connections, and birth islands with gradual inherited styles.

metadata.label: Organic Regions & Motion
metadata.description: Reusable weighted organic regions with the Living Painting sheet deformation and site motion.

field.label: Regions
field.description: Region geometry and motion shader fragments with their current numeric values.

ornament.label: Ornament regions
ornament.description: Layered analytic ornament regions with stable ownership, local coordinates, and visible boundaries.

controlDescriptions.ornamentComplexity: Adds organic variation and layered lobe detail.
controlDescriptions.ornamentConcavity: Deepens the carved bays within the broad regions.
controlDescriptions.ornamentCorridorWidth: Sets the width of winding connections and thin necks.
controlDescriptions.ornamentGrowth: Sets the amount of slow region breathing.
controlDescriptions.ornamentMotion: Sets the subtle attached motion of each region.
controlDescriptions.ornamentNesting: Controls the presence and size of nested islands.
controlDescriptions.ornamentSize: Overall scale of the broad ornament regions.

metadata.label: Organic Boundary Ink
metadata.description: Uneven warm outlines, hand-drawn character, and stationary paper grain for compatible painting renderers.

field.label: Boundary ink
field.description: Boundary and paper-finish shader fragment with its current numeric values.

ornament.label: Ornament boundary ink
ornament.description: Shared-boundary ornament ink helper with its current stroke values.

controlDescriptions.ornamentAccent: Teal and purple secondary-edge strength for Living Ornament.
controlDescriptions.ornamentWidth: Boundary width for Living Ornament shared visible edges.

metadata.label: Decorated Ribbons
metadata.description: Region-attached ladders, pearl beads, and transverse ribbon stripes with independent live multipliers.

pattern.label: Ribbons
pattern.description: Decorated ribbon coverage helper and current pattern multipliers.

controlDescriptions.density: Multiplies the shared ornament density for ribbon cells and beads.
controlDescriptions.motion: Multiplies the shared slow motion of region-attached ribbons.
controlDescriptions.variation: Multiplies the shared variation in ribbon bends and cell placement.
controlDescriptions.width: Multiplies the shared ornament stroke width for rails, rungs, and pearl rims.

metadata.label: Spiral Fill
metadata.description: A reusable field of tightly packed, region-attached spiral ink marks.

pattern.label: Spirals
pattern.description: Packed spiral helper and its current multiplier values.

controlDescriptions.density: Multiplies the painting’s spiral packing density.
controlDescriptions.motion: Multiplies the painting’s subtle spiral motion.
controlDescriptions.variation: Multiplies the painting’s spiral size and placement variation.
controlDescriptions.width: Multiplies the painting’s spiral ink width.

schema.label: Tension and release
schema.description: Slow build, crest, release, and rest. Shapes lead; linework and color follow.

schema.label: Tension
schema.description: Strength of local pressure, contrasting line directions, and rhythmic compression.

schema.label: Large and small rhythm
schema.description: Large anchor regions alternate with smaller supporting regions.

schema.label: Average spacing
schema.description: Overall spacing scale. Each region keeps its own spacing ratio.

schema.label: Overall bend
schema.description: Strength of distinct regional styles: restrained lines, sweeping curves, fans, and contours.

schema.label: Direction bias
schema.description: Shifts the overall direction while preserving regional relationships.

schema.label: Average ink weight
schema.description: Overall stroke weight. Dense patterns tend toward finer strokes; open patterns can carry heavier marks.

schema.label: Neighboring harmony
schema.description: Neighboring patterns share direction, with occasional opposing accents.
